questions.question: Which edition of the National Para Athletics Championship is set to take place in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**23rd Edition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 23rd National Para Athletics Championship 2025 will take place from February 17 to 20, bringing together over 1,700 para-athletes from across India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 23rd edition of the National Para Athletics Championship will be held in Chennai from February 17-20, 2025.**
 
• The championship will feature over 1,700 para-athletes, celebrating resilience, determination, and sporting excellence.
 
• The unveiling ceremony for the logo and mascot was attended by several dignitaries, including Atulya Misra, Additional Chief Secretary of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The event will showcase Tamil Nadu’s commitment to the empowerment of para-athletes and its growing role as a global sporting hub.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Para Athletics Championship__

 __
 
• The championship is an important event for para-athletes in India, providing a platform for showcasing their skills and abilities.
 
• It celebrates inclusivity, accessibility, and the achievements of athletes with disabilities.
 
 
 
• Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu (SDAT)__
 
 
• SDAT is playing a key role in organizing the championship, further establishing Tamil Nadu as a hub for sports development.
 
• SDAT is also sponsoring other significant events like the SDAT-Asia Triathlon Cup.

questions.question: What is the name of the book written by Shri Amitabh Kant about India's G20 Presidency and Summit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**How India Scaled Mt G20.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi lauds Amitabh Kant’s book on India’s G20 Presidency and Summit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book is titled 'How India Scaled Mt G20.'**
 
• The book highlights the rigorous process behind the New Delhi Leader's Declaration for the G20 summit, including 16 failed drafts.
 
• The book details the 300 hours of discussions and 11 sleepless nights required to finalize the declaration.
 
• PM Modi praised the book for providing a lucid perspective on India’s human-centric development efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Amitabh Kant__

 
 
• Former CEO of NITI Aayog
 
• Played a key role in India’s G20 Presidency
 
• Author of 'How India Scaled Mt G20'

questions.question: Which department organized a 3-day event to celebrate 75 years of India's Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Posts.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Department of Posts organized a three-day event to celebrate 75 years of the adoption of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• The event is being held at the National Philatelic Museum in New Delhi.
 
• The event features a variety of engaging activities for visitors of all ages, focused on the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Department of Posts organized a special event marking the 75th anniversary of the adoption of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• The event is being held at the National Philatelic Museum, showcasing the significance of the Constitution through stamps and other materials.
 
• The activities during the event are designed for people of all ages, making it an inclusive celebration.
 
• This event underscores the importance of India’s Constitution and celebrates its legacy and impact on the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Constitution__

 __
 
• The Constitution of India is the supreme law of India, providing the legal framework for the country's governance.
 
• It was adopted on 26 November 1949, and is one of the longest written constitutions in the world.
 
• It ensures fundamental rights, justice, and equality for all Indian citizens.
 
 
 
• National Philatelic Museum__
 
 
• The National Philatelic Museum in New Delhi is dedicated to preserving and showcasing India's postal history and philatelic collection.
 
• The museum is an important institution for promoting the hobby of stamp collection and educating the public about India’s postal heritage.

questions.question: Where was the 'Divya Kala Mela' 2025, celebrating Divyang talent and empowerment, held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vadodara.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 11-day Divya Kala Mela, celebrating Divyang talent and empowerment, concluded at Akota Stadium, Vadodara, on January 19, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Over 100 Divyang artisans and entrepreneurs from 20 States and Union Territories showcased their products at the event.**
 
• The fair promoted the government’s ‘Vocal for Local’ initiative, empowering Divyangjans economically and culturally.
 
• Gujarat’s 30 Divyangjans received loan sanction letters worth ₹1 crore, and motorized tricycles and assistive devices were distributed to 25 Divyangjans.
 
• The closing ‘Divya Kala Shakti’ programme featured captivating cultural performances by 78 Divyang artists from 15 States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Divya Kala Mela__

 __
 
• An annual event organized by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment to celebrate the talent of Divyangjans (persons with disabilities).
 
• Promotes cultural and economic empowerment through exhibitions, performances, and product showcases.
 
 
 
• Divya Kala Shakti Programme__
 __
 
• A cultural showcase highlighting the artistic abilities of Divyangjans.
 
• Performances include traditional dances, music, and dramatizations from various states.
 
 
 
• Vocal for Local__
 __
 
• An initiative by the Government of India to promote locally made products and support regional artisans and entrepreneurs.
 
• Encourages self-reliance and economic growth.
 
 
 
• Support for Divyangjans__
 
 
• The government distributed loans, assistive devices, and tricycles to enhance the independence and livelihoods of Divyangjans.
 
• Efforts like these align with the vision of an Atmanirbhar Bharat (self-reliant India).

questions.question: Who won the men's and women's singles titles at the 2025 Australian Open?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jannik Sinner and Madison Keys**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **2025 Australian Open** was held from **January 12–26, 2025**, at **Melbourne Park**, marking the **113th edition** of the tournament and the **first Grand Slam** of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The tournament featured events for **professional players** in **singles**, **doubles**, **mixed doubles**, as well as **junior** and **wheelchair competitions**.
 
• **Jannik Sinner** of Italy successfully defended his title in the **men’s singles**, defeating **Alexander Zverev** of Germany with a scoreline of **6–3, 7–6(7–4), 6–3**.
 
• In the **women’s singles**, **Madison Keys** (USA) triumphed over **Aryna Sabalenka**, the two-time defending champion, in a hard-fought match ending **6–3, 2–6, 7–5**.
 
• The **men’s doubles** title was claimed by **Harri Heliövaara (Finland)** and **Henry Patten (UK)** after a thrilling victory over **Simone Bolelli** and **Andrea Vavassori (Italy)** with scores of **6–7(16–18), 7–6(7–5), 6–3**.
 
• In the **women’s doubles**, the team of **Kateřina Siniaková (Czech Republic)** and **Taylor Townsend (USA)** defeated **Hsieh Su-wei** (Chinese Taipei) and **Jeļena Ostapenko** (Latvia) with a score of **6–2, 6–7(4–7), 6–3**.
 
• The **mixed doubles** title was an all-Australian affair, with **Olivia Gadecki** and **John Peers** beating **Kimberly Birrell** and **John-Patrick Smith**, scoring **3–6, 6–4, [10–6]**.
 
• In the **wheelchair men’s singles**, **Alfie Hewett** (UK) defeated **Tokito Oda** (Japan) with a score of **6–4, 6–4**, while **Yui Kamiji** (Japan) won the **wheelchair women’s singles**, defeating **Aniek van Koot** (Netherlands) **6–2, 6–2**.
 
• The **wheelchair quad singles** title was clinched by **Sam Schröder** (Netherlands) after defeating **Niels Vink** (Netherlands) **7–6(9–7), 7–5**.
 
• **Alfie Hewett** and **Gordon Reid** (UK) secured the **wheelchair men’s doubles** by defeating **Daniel Caverzaschi (Spain)** and **Stéphane Houdet (France)** **6–2, 6–4**.
 
• The **wheelchair women’s doubles** winners were **Li Xiaohui** and **Wang Ziying** (China), who triumphed over **Manami Tanaka (Japan)** and **Zhu Zhenzhen (China)** **6–2, 6–3**.
 
• In the **junior boys’ singles**, **Henry Bernet** (Switzerland) emerged victorious over **Benjamin Willwerth** (USA) **6–3, 6–4**, while **Wakana Sonobe** (Japan) dominated **Kristina Penickova** (USA) **6–0, 6–1** to win the **junior girls’ singles**.
 
• The **junior boys’ doubles** was won by **Maxwell Exsted (USA)** and **Jan Kumstát (Czech Republic)** after defeating **Ognjen Milić (Serbia)** and **Egor Pleshivtsev** **7–6(8–6), 6–3**.
 
• The **junior girls’ doubles** title went to **Annika Penickova** and **Kristina Penickova (USA)**, who beat **Emerson Jones (Australia)** and **Hannah Klugman (UK)** **6–4, 6–2**.
 
• **Wheelchair boys’ singles** champion **Charlie Cooper** (USA) defeated **Alexander Lantermann (Belgium)** **6–2, 6–2**, while **Vitória Miranda (Brazil)** claimed the **wheelchair girls’ singles** title with a comeback victory over **Sabina Czauz (USA)** **0–6, 6–3, 7–6(10–4)**.
 
• **Luiz Calixto (Brazil)** and **Charlie Cooper (USA)** won the **wheelchair boys’ doubles**, defeating **Alexander Lantermann (Belgium)** and **Benjamin Wenzel (Australia)** **6–3, 6–0**.
 
• The **wheelchair girls’ doubles** was secured by **Luna Gryp (Belgium)** and **Vitória Miranda (Brazil)**, who overpowered **Sabina Czauz (USA)** and **Ailina Mosko (Latvia)** **6–1, 6–1**.

questions.question: Which state won the first prize for the best tableau in the Republic Day Parade 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh won the first prize for the best tableau at the Republic Day Parade 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh’s tableau was themed "Mahakumbh 2025 - Swarnim Bharat: Virasat aur Vikas".**
 
• It depicted the grand Mahakumbh festival, a significant religious and cultural event.
 
• **Tripura and Andhra Pradesh secured the second and third positions, respectively.**
 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs won the best tableau among Central Ministries for "Janjatiya Gaurav Varsh".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Popular Choice Awards (MyGov Poll)__

 __
 
• Gujarat’s tableau "Swarnim Bharat: Virasat Aur Vikas" won the **first prize** in the public voting category.
 
• Uttar Pradesh secured the **second position** in the public poll for "Mahakumbh 2025".
 
• Uttarakhand ranked **third** with a tableau on "Cultural Heritage and Adventure Sports".
 
 
 
• Best Marching Contingents__
 
 
• Among **Services**, the **Jammu & Kashmir Rifles Contingent** won first place.
 
• Among **CAPFs/auxiliary forces**, **Delhi Police Marching Contingent** was awarded the best.
 
• In **Popular Choice Category**, the **Signals Contingent** (Services) and **CRPF Contingent** (CAPFs) won.

questions.question: Who was recently honored with the Maharaja Hari Singh Award 2024-25 in Jammu and Kashmir?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Sinha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir, Manoj Sinha, was honored with the Maharaja Hari Singh Peace and Harmony Award 2024-25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The award was presented to Manoj Sinha at a ceremony held at Satyam Resort, Jammu.**
 
• The award recognizes significant contributions towards peace and harmony in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Manoj Sinha highlighted Maharaja Hari Singh’s role in integrating Jammu and Kashmir with India.
 
• The event was part of a broader Republic Day celebration in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Maharaja Hari Singh__

 __
 
• Last ruling Maharaja of Jammu and Kashmir (1925-1947).
 
• Signed the Instrument of Accession in 1947, integrating J&K with India.
 
• Known for social reforms and modernization efforts in J&K.
 
 
 
• Other Events During the Celebration__
 
 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Academy of Art, Culture, and Languages hosted the All India Urdu Mushaira.
 
• Renowned poets from across India participated in the event at Abhinav Theatre, Jammu.

questions.question: Christine Carla Kangaloo, President of _________, was awarded the Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Award 2025.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Trinidad and Tobago.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Christine Carla Kangaloo, President of Trinidad and Tobago, was awarded the Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Award 2025 for her exceptional contributions to public affairs and strengthening India’s global prestige.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kangaloo is the President of Trinidad and Tobago and an Indo-Trinidadian leader.**
 
• She served as the chief guest for the 18th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
 
• She emphasized the deep-rooted ties between India and Trinidad, dating back to 1845.
 
• Kangaloo praised India’s achievements in education, medicine, mathematics, and navigation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Award__

 __
 
• This is the highest honor conferred upon overseas Indians for their exceptional contributions in various fields.
 
• It aims to recognize individuals who have strengthened the ties between India and the global diaspora.
 
 
 
• Christine Carla Kangaloo__
 __
 
• She is the first Indo-Trinidadian President of Trinidad and Tobago.
 
• Her leadership highlights the contributions of the Indian diaspora to global cultural, social, and economic progress.
 
 
 
• 18th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas__
 
 
• Held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from January 8-10, 2025.
 
• A platform for collaboration between India and its diaspora, celebrating the resilience and heritage of people of Indian origin.
